history.created_by: RUN /bin/sh -c apk add --no-cache bash ca-certificates tzdata zstd su-exec=0.3-r0  postgresql17=17.11-r0 postgresql17-client=17.11-r0 postgresql17-contrib=17.11-r0 # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c mkdir -p /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d /var/lib/postgresql/data /var/run/postgresql  && chown postgres:postgres /var/lib/postgresql/data /var/run/postgresql  && chmod 700 /var/lib/postgresql/data && chmod 3775 /var/run/postgresql  && echo "listen_addresses = '*'" >> "$(pg_config --sharedir)/postgresql.conf.sample" # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh  && echo '1692706708ac7d9c9f9718c1fa4b23abbcc2feecd1416eb51320cefe75f18a5d  /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh' | sha256sum -c -  && postgres --version # buildkit
